items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: most of the guys like Barney Bigard and Omar Simeon and all those clarinet players started on clarinet

ctx.x: But in the early years was it true that they started more on C melody?

Well, the saxophone players started on C melody but mostly the clarinet players, most of the guys like Barney Bigard and Omar Simeon and all those clarinet players started on clarinet because the clarinet is a much more difficult instrument to learn than the saxophone. But I just did it backwards because I guess by me being an ear player the saxophone was much easier, probably. Then I forgot to mention Sidney Bechet, of course, who was one of the all great all time reed men as far as clarinet and saxophone was…
